scope: Historical workstation measurements through the parallel-frame player. Absolute local paths, network endpoints, raw recordings, and process IDs are omitted. Diagnostic flags and cases distinguish disabled evidence from full recording.
sampling: All retained phases include exact summary precision to six decimal places. Selected cases also include the original individual measured frame intervals rounded to one microsecond.
